summary.text: Adam Lowe is a Republican state senator from Calhoun who represents Tennessee Senate District 1 (Bradley, Meigs, McMinn and Rhea counties) and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
He is a college professor and corporate professional development consultant who is vice-chair of the Senate Energy, Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Adam Lowe was born on January 8, 1981, and is married with four children, according to the Tennessee General Assembly.
He holds a B.A. from Lee University, a master's degree in public administration from the University of Tennessee at Chattanooga and a Ph.D. from the University of Tennessee at Knoxville.
His legislative biography lists his profession as a Christian college professor and corporate professional development consultant.
Lowe is a former vice chairman of the Bradley County Commission, where he also served as education chairman and chairman of the Tornado Recovery Fund.

He has been a member of the Senate for the 113th and 114th General Assemblies and serves on the Education and State and Local Government committees and the Council on Pensions, in addition to his vice-chair post.
His community involvement includes volunteering and consulting for the Boys & Girls Clubs of the Ocoee Region and serving on the SETHRA board.
